## Design

### 2026-10-09 – Hey

**2.68h**

Hey
Today I worked on the main design of PocketBeam-The greatest torch

![Screenshot 2026-10-09 at 2.28.22 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ZkeD5nruv5f487p8YJ0VIG1jbnbUmNI4/c1c4a6a6d4f3357bf265bbc5e024face6e3f0a02deee9432ad39929ec02875cd.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-09 at 2.28.03 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ZkeD5nruv5f487p8YJ0VIG1jbnbUmNI4/e9d2a0456d736e803d7db7e79a667e5d455260b781eceb89d375dfa9dddf7197.png)

 ever made!
I   started PCB for the first time and built the main parts in schematic editor. It includes resistors, leds, aa battery pin, capacitator, and a switch. I changed the design form single led to 3 leds in parallel and each resistor has 100ohm resistance. I added markings so assembly would be easier. I also added holes for screws incase they would be needed.  I spent a lot of time on the pcb connections and  layout. The board is 68x44mm.  I ran electricity and design checks and after that I removed  ALL of the connections to have a cleaner finish. I will do the remaining work hopefully soon! I worked on a mac while chatgpt guided me on my windows pc. ALL WORK WAS DONE MANUALLY BY ME MYSELF. Sry about the whatsapp pic in the middle of the menu!!!

### 2026-10-10 – Sooooo I mean today I worked on polishing the ppcb board anc circuit. I changed shapes, rewired routes and vias and added multiple components. Till now it has resistors, leds, a buzzer, a battery and

**2.57h**

Sooooo I mean today I worked on polishing the ppcb board anc circuit. I changed shapes, rewired routes and vias and added multiple components. Till now it has resistors, leds, a buzzer, a battery and a light or darkness detector for when it gets dark. NO MORE SCARY NIGHT. BTW I forgot to resume lapse (lookout) in between for 20 mins so thats why Iput additional time 0.33 hrs.
